title: Sick Of It
style: Dark fantasy video game character art: painterly, detailed, gritty, warm rim light from hellfire, readable silhouette.
notes: Story first (sickofitgame-unity/Docs/Story.md): the climb through 1,000 floors of Hell, Hell is repetition, slimes are villagers and never enemies, no office or work jokes. Enemy art for the game goes through Tools/Art/art.mjs (it calls Hawkes Gen); these presets are for concepts, backdrops and music. The style line is the one art.mjs uses.

enemy-concept.description: A Hell enemy concept, full body side view on green (feed it to art.mjs as a reference).
enemy-concept.prompt: {prompt}. Full-body side profile view, turned to face right, centered with empty space around it; the whole body visible. A single creature, nothing else. {style} Plain flat pure green background, no floor, no shadow.

floor-backdrop.description: A side-view background for a stretch of Hell's floors.
floor-backdrop.prompt: Side-scrolling video game background, a floor of Hell: {prompt}. Empty of characters, layered depth, {style}

floor-music.description: A floor theme: 90s arcade energy, loopable.
floor-music.prompt: {prompt}, 90s arcade video game soundtrack, driving, loopable, instrumental

announcer.description: Hell's announcer line (booming 90s arcade). Set voice to the announcer voice id from audio.json.
